cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Anything but That Question
cards.instruction: Redirect every attempt to discuss the one detail that could expose your real motive or involvement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use the sunset photo for our anniversary card. Keep the horizon level when you crop it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who's holding your hand at the edge?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Crop from that edge, please. We need room for the message, not an inventory of everyone on the beach.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I zoomed in. That person's wearing your bracelet. Who is it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Zoom back out. We're printing a card, not inspecting jewelry. Use the wide shot.
